text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Sighing like that—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine. Something of this degree 
poses no problem."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"To reach the top... this is just another 
wall I must overcome."

Even so, it's clear she's exhausted. I 
might need to reconsider Grass Wonder's 
upcoming race schedule...
